purpose: Evidence-first registry for organizations, people, money, media, political activity, security actors and subcultural ecosystems.
principles: Map relationships rather than isolated entities.
Separate documented facts from interpretation and hypotheses.
Never infer secret control from shared ideology, geography, funding category or social proximity alone.
Couple organizations to countries through explicit relationship types.
Track time, money, scale and confidence separately.

evidence_levels.primary: Official filings, contracts, registries, court records, audited accounts or direct organizational publications.
evidence_levels.secondary: Credible independent reporting or research that identifies and contextualizes the relationship.
evidence_levels.interpretive: Project interpretation derived from documented relationships.
evidence_levels.hypothesis: Unverified possibility retained for research and explicitly excluded from factual conclusions.

special_rules.people: Do not assign faction, cult, handler or secret-network labels without evidence. Prefer observable affiliations and relationships.
special_rules.armed_groups: Record factual status, geography, dates, financing and designations; do not provide operational assistance.
special_rules.ambiguous_names: Do not create a canonical node until identity and jurisdiction can be established.
special_rules.money: Distinguish revenue, spending, grants, donations, contracts, assets and profit.
special_rules.ownership: Distinguish legal ownership from effective control and management influence.
